subject: [PATCH 05/60] mm/mempolicy: keep interleave and tmpfs mount policies on common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer Gregory Relay noted that the patch incorrectly uses N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of N_MEMORY in several places, including for_each_node_state() loops and node_states[] checks, which could lead to incorrect behavior when dealing with non-common memory nodes.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory policy module to use a new concept called N_MEMORY_COMMON when calculating boot policies and their per-node sysfs entries. It restricts the node set for mpol_set_nodemask() and mbind() masks to only include nodes that are part of N_MEMORY_COMMON. Additionally, it updates tmpfs and interleave policies to default to common memory nodes if no specific nodelist is provided. This change aims to simplify policy management by limiting the scope of certain policies to a smaller set of nodes.
